description: This file defines functions for traversing and inspecting a markdown document tree, including block and inline elements, using depth-first traversal. It includes functions for inspecting blocks and inline elements, handling various node types, and managing recursion with stacks.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Interface representing a block element in markdown (e.g., paragraph, list, quote).

classes.name: Inline
classes.description: Interface representing an inline element in markdown (e.g., link, image).

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents the root document node containing child blocks.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Represents a list block containing list items.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: Represents a list item containing child blocks.

classes.name: BlockQuote
classes.description: Represents a block quote containing child blocks.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: Represents an inline image element with potential child nodes.

classes.name: InlineLink
classes.description: Represents an inline link element with potential child nodes.

classes.name: ReferenceImage
classes.description: Represents a reference-style inline image with potential child nodes.

classes.name: ReferenceLink
classes.description: Represents a reference-style inline link with potential child nodes.

methods.name: Inspect
methods.description: Traverses the markdown tree in depth-first order, applying a function to each node.

methods.name: InspectBlock
methods.description: Traverses block elements in depth-first order, applying a function to each block.

methods.name: InspectInline
methods.description: Traverses inline elements in depth-first order, applying a function to each inline node.
